project.title: Chorus of Voices: Sound in Poetry Around the World
project.description: This lesson is intended for use in sophomore level high school classrooms, though it could certainly be adapted for other grade levels in 9-12 education. It serves as an introduction to working with sound in poetry, moving students through the analytical process of close reading a poem (paraphrase → observe → contextualize → analyze → argue → reflect). By the end of the ~50 minute lesson, students will practice applying poetic analysis of sound to their own poem of choice from around the world, culminating in an informal oral analysis.
